source_hints.quote: We have included elongated mediator dots [22] to provide the basic two-qubit gate operation while increasing the fundamental interqubit spacing to more readily accommodate measuring devices for ancilla readout, and electron reservoirs for initialisation and reset of quantum dots.

However, the fundamental operations, such as single-qubit gates [14, 15], entangling gates [16–20], and measurement [21] are known to populate non-computational levels, creating a demand for a reset protocol [22–27] that can remove leakage population from these higher states without adversely impacting performance in a large scale system.
We benchmark the reset gate using the bit-flip error correction code [5] and measure growth and removal of leakage in-situ.
